notes: Statement change in notation only: MultilinearMap is now semilinear and takes a ring homomorphism, so `MultilinearMap B (fun _ : Fin q => L) B` is written `MultilinearMap (RingHom.id B) (fun _ : Fin q => L) B` in p1, p2, p4 and free_of_section. With the identity homomorphism this is exactly the pinned B-multilinear map type, and it matches the already-ported statements of the imported GlobalTheory.T.exists_multilinear_form_of_pic_torsion (M027626), kummerAlgebra_finite_projective_faithfullyFlat (M039984) and kummerAlgebra_zmod_torsor_bijective (M039986), which these theorems restate. Proofs unchanged.
